{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kherkhaman''' was the largest [[Kriek]] tribe on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kriekaal]]. Claiming the entire northern continent of [[Dekok]] as their territory, the Kherkhaman were led by [[Kavakoderakanbnuarria]], with [[Malketh]] serving as their [[kulai]] [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]].<ref name="Scout">{{JournalCite|13|Scouts' Dispatch}}</ref>
